queries: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate_of_kept, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.rate > a.avg_rate

WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) IS NOT NULL THEN sc.zoneref END) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate_of_kept, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.rate > a.avg_rate

WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS r, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), o AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS a FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.r) AS avg_rate, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.r - o.a) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN o WHERE s.r > o.a

WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS n_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), ov AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(per.n_sites * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(per.rate - ov.overall) AS avg_excess FROM per CROSS JOIN ov WHERE per.rate > ov.overall

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average rate is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates, not a pooled average over all scans.
A scan's rate is gbsize/spanmin. Scans with a null gbsize or a null or zero spanmin are left out of the rate. A zero spanmin is treated as missing to avoid division by zero.
The distinct-site count for a status covers all matched scans in that status, including scans whose rate is missing.
Sites with a null healtheval form their own group and take part in the all-status average, as long as their rate is not null.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct sites only among scans that have a valid rate, so scans with missing gbsize or spanmin are excluded from the site count too.
alternatives.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0) IS NOT NULL THEN sc.zoneref END) AS n FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY si.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.rate) AS avg_rate_of_kept, AVG(s.n * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(s.rate - a.avg_rate) AS avg_excess FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.rate > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average rate is the unweighted mean of the per-status average rates. It is not a pooled average over all scans.
A scan with spanmin = 0 is treated as having a missing rate, to avoid division by zero. Scans with null gbsize or spanmin are ignored in the rate. Statuses whose rate is null never pass the filter.
A NULL healtheval, if present, forms its own status group. It is included in the all-status average.

responses.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS n_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), ov AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS overall FROM per) SELECT AVG(per.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(per.n_sites * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(per.rate - ov.overall) AS avg_excess FROM per CROSS JOIN ov WHERE per.rate > ov.overall

assumptions.assumption: The all-status average is the unweighted mean of the per-status average rates (each status counts once), not the mean over all scans.
A spanmin of 0 is treated as a missing rate (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero. Rows with null gbsize or spanmin are ignored in the rate.
Distinct sites per status counts every matched scan's site, including scans whose rate is missing. A NULL healtheval forms its own group and counts as a status.

alternatives.interpretation: The all-status average is the pooled average rate over all matched scans, rather than the mean of the per-status rates.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(DISTINCT s.zoneregistry) AS n_sites FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), ov AS (SELECT AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS overall FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry) SELECT AVG(per.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(per.n_sites * 1.0) AS avg_distinct_sites, AVG(per.rate - ov.overall) AS avg_excess FROM per CROSS JOIN ov WHERE per.rate > ov.overall
